note: A recipe is what makes a tier CLAIM true at render: signal tags (the claim), carriers (the mechanism), counter-NEG (the boundary), prose floor (what survives PH). The rating gate grades every slot against its declared tier's recipe.

PG13.name: the tease tier
PG13.carrier_note: skin-framing (S) and exposure-positioning (E) lead; fabric states stay non-sheer; B shape-telegraph at L/M degree
PG13.prose_floor: state nouns >= 2; the outfit IS the claim

R.name: the underwear tier
R.carrier_note: layers negotiate (L) and context undresses (U); the D kinetic axis makes the pose erotic (the author's table puts the POSE in the signal set); waistband/strap/cup states are the vocabulary
R.prose_floor: state nouns >= 3; underwear state named explicitly, never implied

RPLUS.name: the edge tier

through_fabric.note: RENDER LAW (T4-03, author's eye): the edge reads through ONE thin LIGHT garment (blouse/tee/shirt/knit/swimsuit/leotard/romper/slip) tagged wet clothes AND/OR see-through, with NO underlayer on the zone — the renderer draws the underlayer, not the edge, if one is named. cameltoe never rendered (0/N) — flavor only. Lower-zone claims are guarded by dead_fabrics_lower, chest claims by dead_fabrics_upper (the claim TARGET must be a sheer-able thin fabric). Delivery is stochastic (~1/8): build the best-odds frame, expect re-rolls

on_skin.note: the edge lives ON bare skin (tape, hands) — «topless, naked breasts» MUST be lifted from NEG or the renderer closes the chest (verdict T4-03). Zone carries ≤1 layer + the claim
on_skin.render_risk: experimental — unproven at render (T4-03 OC-2: tape died to the NEG conflict + layers). Lawful only with: lifted counter-NEG, single layer on the zone, claim early in the tag-run. Expect re-rolls; prefer through_fabric when in doubt

RPLUS.carrier_note: sheer/imprint/compression physics; cameltoe is I-class (imprint) by science; CORE-4 mandatory (>=4 classes x 4 mechanism groups); sheer-family <=2 carriers per prompt; the claim zone carries <=1 garment layer + the claim target (layer-clarity law, verdict T4-03)
RPLUS.prose_floor: state nouns >= 4; the hard claim is a RENDER-PROVEN signal (pantyline / nipples through clothing / see-through / tape) on a NAMED thin garment with its fabric state (wet / sheer) named in the TAG BLOCK — prose amplifies what the tags claim, it never substitutes them (render verdict T4-03: the renderer reads the tag-run, not the poetry)

X.name: the bare tier
X.carrier_note: bare-state nouns stated plainly and at least doubled in prose (the render-confirmed half of the old recipe); situational (U) or fantasy amplification stages the bareness; open mouth is an OPTIONAL amplifier, never a requirement (the stub is retired); composition and light do the art — the body is already the claim
X.prose_floor: state nouns >= 4; the bare state named in both tag block and prose (the doubling law); staging (where/light/witness) carries the dignity
X.opener: anime style, ecchi anime style, hentai anime style
X.platform_note: X posts are algorithmically suppressed on Yodayo — art-for-art slots, default 2 per batch
X.render_note: render-proven 2/2 at T4-03: the bare state doubled (tags + prose) PLUS the coverage-block NEG («covered breasts, bra, clothing on chest») makes the renderer commit — the NEG is the tool that renders the tier

render_law.born: 2026-09-21 · render verdict T4-03 (24 renders, author's eye)
laws: the renderer obeys NEG coverage-blocks and fabric-STATE tags (wet clothes / see-through) on thin garments
the renderer ignores shape-name tags: cameltoe never rendered (0 attempts); tape constructs mostly die
an underlayer (bra/camisole/bandeau) under a sheer garment renders the UNDERLAYER — the tier drops to R
3+ layers on a zone = the renderer picks a modest combination (PG-13/R)
signal tags at the TAIL of the tag-run render weak — claims sit in the first ~12 tags
opaque structured fabrics (jeans/denim/leather/velvet/sweatpants/breeches/suit) never carry an edge
R+ delivery is stochastic (~1/8 even when lawful): the gate enforces the best-odds construct, the author re-rolls
render_law.meta: VLM holistic grading OVER-READS the edge tier (VLM said 8/12 R+, the author's eye said 1/15) — edge-tier verdicts belong to the author; the VLM loop may verify scene/structure, never the edge itself
